question: From what inner stance should the practitioner satisfy the host of deities?
premises: The practitioner abides in identity with the goddesses up to the trident.
Standing in that state, he offers the universe.
By this he should satisfy the host of deities.
inference: Satisfaction of the deities is accomplished by offering the universe while identified with the goddess-powers of the trident.
plain_english: Thus, abiding in identity with the goddesses up to the trident, standing here and offering the universe, one should satisfy the host of deities.
